subtitle: Serverless, 100% In-Browser Steam Authenticator
accounts.title: Steam Accounts
accounts.emptyHint: Upload your Steam Desktop Authenticator (.maFile) file or add manually. Your keys are stored completely in your browser (IndexedDB).
accounts.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this account?
confirmations.title: Pending Confirmations
confirmations.noPending: No pending trade or login confirmations.
confirmations.rateLimitDesc: Steam servers temporarily throttled confirmation queries due to frequent requests. Auto-refresh and queries have been paused for {{seconds}}s for security.
confirmations.rateLimitError: Steam temporarily applied a rate limit (HTTP 429). Requests paused for 45 seconds.
confirmations.corsDesc: Steam servers do not allow direct cross-origin requests from web browsers to steamcommunity.com. Your pending trade or market confirmations are ready on Steam.
confirmations.quickSolution: Quick Solution: You can confirm directly on the official signed Steam page with one click.
confirmations.corsOptionsTitle: To Confirm In-App with One Click:
confirmations.corsOpt1: Option 1 (Easiest): Install an 'Allow CORS: Access-Control-Allow-Origin' browser extension from the Chrome Web Store. When reloaded, confirmations will be listed with action buttons.
confirmations.corsOpt2: Option 2: Go to Settings and configure your own local or free Cloudflare Worker CORS Proxy.
confirmations.missingSessionDesc: The steamLoginSecure cookie is required to list trade and market confirmations (2FA codes work offline, but confirmations require a session cookie).
accountDetail.title: Account Details
accountDetail.autoLoginDesc: Enter your Steam username and password to automatically generate and save your steamLoginSecure cookie with one click.
accountDetail.refreshTokenHint: Refreshes session cookie using stored RefreshToken without requiring password.
accountDetail.autoLoginSuccess: Login successful! steamLoginSecure cookie saved and confirmations activated.
settings.title: Settings
settings.connectionDesc: The app communicates directly with api.steampowered.com and steamcommunity.com with zero middleman or backend. All 2FA codes are calculated offline.
settings.corsProxyDesc: Steam servers restrict direct in-browser cross-origin (CORS) requests. If you prefer not to use a browser extension, specify your own proxy here. If empty, direct connection and official Steam pages are used.
settings.proxySecretHint: If you set PROXY_SECRET on your Cloudflare Worker, enter it here.
settings.workerTemplateDesc: Quick guide and ready code to deploy your own free Cloudflare Worker:
settings.timeSyncDesc: Synchronizes time drift between your local device and Steam servers.
settings.syncFailed: Could not reach Steam time server.
settings.backupDesc: Export or restore all your accounts and settings as a secure JSON backup.
settings.offlineTotpInfoDesc: Steam Guard 2FA codes are calculated entirely offline using your device's local clock (RFC 6238 TOTP standard). Since modern devices sync time with internet NTP servers automatically, clock drift is typically 0 seconds. Codes remain 100% valid even without active internet access.
logs.title: Activity Logs
installModal.title: Install SteamWeb
installModal.subtitle: Full-screen standalone mobile app experience
installModal.installBtn: 📲 Add to Home Screen / Install App
installModal.androidStep1: Tap the three-dots menu in the top right corner.
installModal.androidStep2: Select 'Install app' or 'Add to Home screen' from the menu.
installModal.androidStep3: Tap 'Install' in the prompt. The app will be added to your home screen just like from the store!
installModal.iosStep1: Tap the Share icon at the bottom of the Safari screen.
installModal.iosStep2: Scroll down and tap 'Add to Home Screen'.
installModal.iosStep3: Tap 'Add' in the top right. The app will launch in full screen without the Safari URL bar!
